# IconRegistry

media and display · tier 1 · beta · runs in the browser.

<!-- hand-written -->

## When to use

Only in a tree that never renders on the server, such as a Storybook story or a test. It
maps a name to an already-imported icon, which is why it costs bundle size that `<Icon>`
does not.

Prefer `<Icon name>` on the server and `<Svg icon>` in client files. Reach for this
when you genuinely need a name-to-icon lookup in the browser.

<!-- /hand-written -->

## Import

```tsx
import { registerIcons, registeredIcons, Icon } from 'topclassui'
```

## Props

Every prop below is optional and falls back to the default shown.

This component takes no design props of its own.

Anything else on `Icon` is passed to the element it draws, so standard attributes (`onClick`, `aria-*`, `data-*`, `id`) work. `className` is merged last, so yours wins a conflict, and `ref` is a normal prop.

## Verified against

Base UI: not used by this component.
